title.en: How a board moves through the shop

path: Overview › Pipeline · Service › a job card · Service › What has stalled

en: Know the 4 stages: Pre-Repair → In-Repair → Repair Completed → Closed. Each has its own sub-statuses.
Pre-Repair (Inward, Under Assessment, Awaiting Customer Input, Awaiting Quotation Approval): Front Office books it in; Liaison or Service Head assess and quote.
In-Repair (Alloted, In Progress, Pending Spare, On Hold): Service Head or Liaison allots; the engineer repairs.
On Hold is the Service Head's or Liaison's call: Put on hold from In Progress, saying what it is waiting for; Release hold sends it back to In Progress. The engineer cannot hold.
Repair Completed (Ready for Verification, In Verification, Awaiting Customer Confirmation): a second engineer verifies; the Liaison runs customer testing.
Closed: Ready for Invoice (goes on an invoice batch), Non-Repairable or Customer Rejected.
Read a job's sub-status before you act. It tells you whose turn it is. This job so far shows every move, when and by whom.
ta: 4 ஸ்டேஜ் தெரிஞ்சுக்கோங்க: Pre-Repair → In-Repair → Repair Completed → Closed. ஒவ்வொண்ணுக்கும் தனி sub-status இருக்கு.
Pre-Repair (Inward, Under Assessment, Awaiting Customer Input, Awaiting Quotation Approval): Front Office Inward பண்ணுவாங்க; Liaison அல்லது Service Head அசெஸ் பண்ணி கொட்டேஷன் தருவாங்க.
In-Repair (Alloted, In Progress, Pending Spare, On Hold): Service Head அல்லது Liaison அலாட் பண்ணுவாங்க; இன்ஜினியர் ரிப்பேர் பண்ணுவாங்க.
On Hold போடுறது Service Head அல்லது Liaison தான்: In Progress-ல இருந்து Put on hold, எதுக்கு வெயிட் பண்ணுதுன்னு எழுதணும். Release hold போட்டா திரும்ப In Progress. இன்ஜினியர் Hold போட முடியாது.
Repair Completed (Ready for Verification, In Verification, Awaiting Customer Confirmation): வேற ஒரு இன்ஜினியர் வெரிஃபை பண்ணுவாங்க; Liaison கஸ்டமர் டெஸ்டிங் பண்ணுவாங்க.
Closed: Ready for Invoice (இன்வாய்ஸ் பேட்ச்ல சேரும்), Non-Repairable, அல்லது Customer Rejected.
எதுவும் பண்றதுக்கு முன்னாடி ஜாபோட sub-status பாருங்க. யாரோட டர்ன்னு அது சொல்லும். This job so far-ல ஒவ்வொரு மூவும், எப்போ, யாருன்னு இருக்கும்.

en: Don't try to log hours on a job at Pending Spare or On Hold. They mean paused, and the system refuses the time (their “No time logging” flag).
Don't expect a Closed job to be reopened. A lead can send an open job back to the engineer (Send it back to the engineer, with a reason); a board that returns after closing is a new Rework job.
Don't keep work outside the system. Time in each sub-status is measured, and a job sitting too long shows as Stuck.
Don't judge a job by the day it arrived. Days on What has stalled count from entering the current sub-status.
ta: Pending Spare அல்லது On Hold-ல இருக்கற ஜாப்ல ஹவர்ஸ் போடாதீங்க. வேலை நிக்குதுன்னு அர்த்தம்; சிஸ்டம் ஏத்துக்காது (அவங்களுக்கு “No time logging” ஃப்ளாக் இருக்கு).

Closed ஜாப் திரும்ப ஓப்பன் ஆகும்னு எதிர்பாக்காதீங்க. ஓப்பன் ஜாபை மட்டும் லீட் திரும்ப இன்ஜினியருக்கு அனுப்பலாம் (Send it back to the engineer, காரணத்தோட). Closed ஆன பிறகு திரும்ப வர்ற போர்டு = புது Rework ஜாப்.
வேலையை சிஸ்டத்துக்கு வெளியே வெச்சுக்காதீங்க. ஒவ்வொரு sub-status-லயும் டைம் கணக்காகும்; ரொம்ப நாள் நின்னா Stuck-ன்னு காட்டும்.
போர்டு வந்த நாளை வெச்சு ஜாபை எடை போடாதீங்க. What has stalled-ல Days = இப்போ இருக்கற sub-status-க்கு வந்ததுல இருந்து.

en.q: A job is at Pending Spare. The engineer wants to book 2 hours on it today. What happens?
o: The hours are saved as usual
The system refuses: the job is paused waiting for a part
The hours go to the Service Head for approval
en.why: Pending Spare and On Hold carry the “No time logging” flag, so time is refused. The job has to be back In Progress first.

en.q: A board closed as Ready for Invoice last month comes back with the same fault. What do you do?
o: Send the closed job back to the engineer
Change its status by hand to In Progress
Register it as a new Rework job
en.why: A closed job is never reopened. Send it back works only on open jobs; a returning board is a new Rework job linked to the old one.

en.q: Which stage holds Awaiting Customer Confirmation?
en.why: Repair Completed: Ready for Verification, In Verification, Awaiting Customer Confirmation. The Liaison records the customer's test.

en.q: On What has stalled, a job shows 21 in the Days column. What does 21 count?
o: Days since the board arrived at the counter
Days since it entered its current sub-status
Days since the engineer last logged in
en.why: The queue measures time in the current state, not the board's age.

ta.q: ஒரு ஜாப் Pending Spare-ல இருக்கு. இன்ஜினியர் இன்னைக்கு அதுல 2 ஹவர்ஸ் போடணும்னு நினைக்கறாங்க. என்ன ஆகும்?
ta.why: Pending Spare, On Hold ரெண்டுலயும் “No time logging” ஃப்ளாக் இருக்கு; டைம் ஏத்துக்காது. முதல்ல ஜாப் திரும்ப In Progress வரணும்.

ta.q: போன மாசம் Ready for Invoice-ஆ Closed ஆன போர்டு அதே ஃபால்ட்டோட திரும்ப வருது. என்ன பண்ணுவீங்க?
ta.why: Closed ஜாப் திரும்ப ஓப்பன் ஆகாது. Send it back ஓப்பன் ஜாப்ஸுக்கு மட்டும். திரும்ப வர்ற போர்டு = பழைய ஜாபோட லிங்க் ஆன புது Rework ஜாப்.

ta.q: Awaiting Customer Confirmation எந்த ஸ்டேஜ்ல இருக்கு?
ta.why: Repair Completed: Ready for Verification, In Verification, Awaiting Customer Confirmation. கஸ்டமர் டெஸ்டை Liaison பதிவு பண்ணுவாங்க.

ta.q: What has stalled-ல ஒரு ஜாபுக்கு Days காலத்துல 21 இருக்கு. 21 எதைக் குறிக்குது?
o: இப்போ இருக்கற sub-status-க்கு வந்ததுல இருந்து நாட்கள்
இன்ஜினியர் கடைசியா லாகின் பண்ணதுல இருந்து நாட்கள்
ta.why: க்யூ, இப்போ இருக்கற ஸ்டேட்டஸ்ல எவ்ளோ நாள்னு அளக்குது; போர்டோட வயசை இல்ல.

notes: The brief and the old draft said a lead can send a CLOSED job back. The app refuses it: return_to_engineer() raises “Work order … is closed. Register a rework job against it rather than reopening this one.”, and the job card hides Send it back on terminal jobs. The clip teaches that open jobs can be sent back (not from In Progress) and closed ones become Rework jobs.

The draft line “Add a short note when you change status” was not taught: status changes carry notes only in specific acts (Send it back and Put on hold need a reason, Release hold says what cleared it, Pending Spare records what it waits for); there is no general note field.

Two different “stuck” measures exist: What has stalled (Service) lists jobs past the threshold by time in the current state (it excludes boards waiting on a part), while Overview › Stuck tasks counts Alloted/In Progress jobs with no timesheet, part or status activity for N business days. The clip only says “sitting too long in one state shows as Stuck”.

Round 2: Put on hold / Release hold (Service Head, Liaison; from In Progress, reason required) is named in a caption over the pipeline's On Hold line, not demonstrated; module 05 demonstrates it. The time refusal now follows each sub-status's “No time logging” (blocks_labour) flag (migration 0157); Pending Spare and On Hold carry it.
Filmed as admin.test@ (Admin sees every screen). The job shown is read, never changed: the open job with the longest history, preferring Pending Spare (WO/26-27/00005 in these takes).
On the job card the Non-Repairable act is labelled “It cannot be saved…” in red, which at a glance reads like an error message (UX, not fixed).

Round 3: re-recorded on develop with the Rack & Bin look. The pipeline strip now opens with a Sourcing column (customers, not boards, outside the total); the stage pointers (Pre-Repair … Closed) are unchanged and the captions still hold. What has stalled › Stuck leaves out boards waiting on a part (chased on Spares). Durations: EN 73 s, TA 93 s (title cards: about 70 / 90 seconds).
